purpose: Regenerate one locked-V9-only three-pose source panel after V32 attempt 2 passed semantic inspection but failed the half-eye component budget. Keep high functional discrimination while making all three functional parts per state thin, hollow and individually below the V9 half-eye ink budget. Menu must retain three readable page tabs; Recording must retain one mouth, two receiver cuffs and pickup; Charging must retain a continuous connected coupler-to-tether-to-dock topology.
v9_identity_and_simplicity_invariants: retain exact locked V9 floating-face identity: black oval eyes, one oval highlight and one diamond sparkle per eye, eye scale/spacing/baseline, nose, cheeks, line weight, wide white margins and no enclosing head, hair, ears, helmet, body, frame or card

each state has exactly three separately extractable black functional components; each component is hollow or thin-stroked, has a white interior when enclosed, and has at most 504 thresholded native-200 ink pixels
each functional component is visibly smaller than half a V9 eye, never a filled block, and never covers an eye or brow
mouths differ pairwise by pixel mask, topology, endpoint pattern and curvature; no shared, offset or scale-only mouth is permitted

menu is three thin outlined page tabs with a raised notched centre; recording is two open receiver cuffs plus one pickup dot; charging is a continuous thin side-coupler-to-tether-to-slotted-dock route
no literal battery, lightning, microphone, waveform, plug, menu icon, text, label, detached UI widget, generic emotion substitution, headband, costume or whole-face prop

state_object_semantic_brief.one_glance_read: navigation and choosing, not hair, dots or a crown
state_object_semantic_brief.mouth_action: short straight decision mouth with a single centred downward selection notch
state_object_semantic_brief.topology: three small outline-only page tabs above the brows. The centre is only subtly taller, has one tiny white folded-corner notch, and must not be filled black or substantially larger than either side tab.

state_object_semantic_brief.one_glance_read: active capture and attentive listening, not surprise, moustache or costume headset
state_object_semantic_brief.mouth_action: exactly one shallow wide rounded horizontal listening capsule below the nose; no duplicate, stacked or second inner mouth
state_object_semantic_brief.topology: two thin open C cuffs with one inward contact tick each, plus one small round pickup dot to the right of the mouth; no bridge, earcup, boom, microphone or waveform

state_object_semantic_brief.one_glance_read: connected power transfer and recovery, not a decorative star/string
state_object_semantic_brief.mouth_action: small smooth upward recovery smile with a white interior
state_object_semantic_brief.topology: a small open coupler at the left cheek joins one thin short continuous tether which visibly touches a small hollow rounded dock above the brows. The dock has a horizontal white contact slot. Each part remains individually below the half-eye budget even though the tether connects the endpoints.

source_gate_readability_requirements: native 200x200 crops are internally assignable as Menu, Recording and Charging without captions
each of the nine declared functional components has 8 through 504 thresholded ink pixels, no unwanted overlap and an explicit source crop
menu has three small separated hollow page-tab silhouettes; a filled or oversized centre tab fails
recording has one mouth, two open cuffs and a pickup dot; a duplicate/stacked mouth fails
charging has a thin 8-connected tether from side coupler to slotted dock; disconnected ornamentation fails
all states have pairwise different mouth masks and no forbidden object before export or owner review
machine_preconditions_before_owner_revie: source gate validates locked-V9-only lineage, native-200 component budget, exact component topology, mouth pairwise difference and state readability
component export uses only locked V9 identity components plus source-derived V32 masks with zero overlap and no full-face substitution
browser and target PBM replay one deterministic native-200 component plan

internal visual preflight rejects shared mouths, unreadable semantics, duplicate recording mouth, disconnected charging topology, oversize/filled/costume components and source misuse before an owner prompt
